key_notes: Key 1 (t=2.06s): Initial archival pose of suitcase; Quick, Draw! + Rotoscope centerline established.
Key 2 (t=3.19s): Mid-sequence articulation of suitcase; 2x2 smooth cage tracks primary motion.
Key 3 (t=4.42s): Peak dynamic extension of suitcase over 7-plane multiplane environment.
Key 4 (t=5.66s): Follow-through and settle of suitcase with watertight SAM cel backing.
why_continuous: Continuous 3.6s archival shot of suitcase (2.06s..5.66s) selected by edge clarity and temporal coherence.
